title: hebea parviflora
intro: Hebea parviflora, commonly known as the dwarf Hebe, is a flowering plant species in the family Plantaginaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Hebea parviflora include iridoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
